video.title: AI欧腐《五个Alpha求我回来/All Five Alphas Want Me Back》
video.desc:
路边的野狼不要捡 恩
Oliver, a Beta, raised five abandoned Alpha cubs and saved them twice, but a maid stole the credit. Believing her, the five brothers humiliate him for her sake. So Oliver rejects all five as mates and marries the ruthless Alpha King Felix, their own uncle. When the truth comes out, the five realize who they loved — too late.
Beta Oliver 一手养大了五只被遗弃的 Alpha 幼崽，还曾两次救过他们的命，功劳却被一个女仆冒领了。五兄弟信了她的话，为了她一次次羞辱 Oliver。于是 Oliver 拒绝了五人的求偶，转身嫁给了冷酷无情的 Alpha 王 Felix——他们的亲叔叔。
